summary: Fixed the gridcalc bugs against the current docs: number exponents, column letters, range normalisation, prefix-minus and right-grouped ^ precedence, empty reads, number-to-text (%.10g), text skipped in SUM/AVERAGE/MIN/MAX ranges, lazy IF, bool typing, cell order, refs dedup and ROUND precision. All unit tests pass and the doc examples were checked directly; overview.md 3.2 says -2^2 is 4, which conflicts with formulas.md 3.4 and the changelog, so I followed formulas.md (-4).
